title: Sword in the Abyss
description: A dark surreal scene shows a large blood-stained sword embedded in the ground at left, gripped by a skeletal hand emerging from a pool of glowing blue liquid. Swirling masses of orange, purple and brown organic forms with embedded jeweled orbs flow from the right, while a glowing orange and blue energy river winds through a dark, chaotic rocky background filled with shattered debris.
